rule: V7 is the single final destination. Professional market making is now the primary economic research and engineering priority inside that master V7 directive. Preserve PAPER-only safety and the single V7 architecture. The previous rejection of unconditional generic improve1 is evidence against that quoting policy, not against the market-making strategy class. Build a reward-aware, inventory-aware, event-driven professional maker inside V7/common using the canonical allocator, ledger, monitoring, deployment and exact-SHA lifecycle. The required lifecycle remains implementation -> tests -> same-SHA PAPER -> main -> paper-validated -> deploy -> server health -> legacy deletion.

paper_v7_authorization.interpretation: 100% is a hard ceiling, not a target. Kelly, executable depth, authoritative fees, spread/slippage, joint completion, partial/unwind loss, adverse markout, capital/latency costs, state integrity and the 15% drawdown kill switch still bind. Professional maker PAPER exploration uses much smaller strategy-specific limits until empirical execution evidence matures.

architecture.target: one slim canonical V7 PAPER codebase
architecture.recovery_after_premature_cleanup: Do not restore retired numerical generations wholesale. Port only required cutover/data/monitoring primitives into V7/common/control-plane and prove them with current V7 tests.
architecture.legacy_rule: Do not add new logic to V3/V4/V5/V6. Any primitive still required by V7 must live in V7/common before final retirement. Git history is the archive.

economic_objective.decision_ev: P(fill_or_joint_completion|X,a) * E[alpha_or_spread_capture-costs-adverse_markout|fill,X,a] - E[partial_fill_unwind_loss|X,a] - capital_cost - latency_cost + conservatively_haircut_maker_rebate + conservatively_haircut_liquidity_reward
economic_objective.market_maker_rule: Directional alpha is not required for a maker quote. Optimize fill-conditioned trading PnL, maker rebates and liquidity rewards as three separate components; reward/subsidy dependence must be explicit. A quote action is admissible when its total controlled EV is positive, or when it is a bounded PAPER exploration probe that receives zero promotion credit.
economic_objective.multi_leg_rule: Estimate the empirical joint completion/state distribution; product or minimum of marginal fill probabilities is not an accepted substitute.
economic_objective.success: positive forward realized PAPER fill-conditioned post-cost PnL with causal data, realistic simulated fills, authoritative fees, executable depth, inventory/unwind losses, markout, reward/rebate attribution, cost stress and no leakage

model_contracts.professional_market_maker: PRIMARY PRIORITY. Treat market making as a microstructure/control problem, not a directional-alpha model. Use shared event-driven C++ WebSocket L2 state; post-only JOIN/IMPROVE/FADE/ONE_SIDED/WITHDRAW actions; empirical action-specific P(fill|X,a); fill-conditioned markout/toxicity; queue and cancel latency; inventory-aware reservation prices; temporary one-sided inventory with explicit full-depth mark/unwind; YES/NO complete-set merge accounting; dynamic reward-market selection; maker rebates and liquidity rewards valued separately with conservative haircuts; reward minimum size never grants capital; bounded cold-start PAPER exploration with no promotion credit; no unconditional improve policy.
model_contracts.fast_structural_arb: always-on secondary structural lane; use event-driven/local L2 state where possible, dual exchange/receive clocks, stale/sequence continuity checks, authoritative per-market fees, executable depth, sequential leg revalidation and explicit partial/unwind accounting
model_contracts.graph_rv: secondary prospective dual-clock joint-state evidence only; queue ahead reduces fillability and must not grant capital; compare maker/maker, maker/taker, taker/maker, taker/taker, sequential, near-simultaneous, join, improve and cross by total executable EV; explicit partial-state unwind
model_contracts.cross_sectional_ranking: lower-priority parallel research; relative top-vs-bottom executable ranking; evaluate 15m, 30m, 1h, 2h and 6h separately; do not pool inference across horizons; frozen holdout model is fit once strictly before holdout_start minus embargo and is never refit inside the frozen holdout; online walk-forward evidence is separate
model_contracts.micro_taker: secondary selective short-horizon round-trip target with entry ask VWAP, expected/realized exit bid VWAP, both authoritative fees, slippage, uncertainty, adverse markout and capital-time costs; open positions mark to full-depth executable liquidation net of exit fee or fail closed
model_contracts.external_intelligence: continue low-cost parallel collection; all features/probability mappings must be point-in-time; raw external features never become a synthetic terminal probability without approved causal mapping and evidence; external signals may be used as toxicity/fair-value context for maker only after causal validation
model_contracts.learned_execution: critical shared service for the primary maker: estimate action-specific P(fill|X,a), fill-conditioned markout, cancel/replace effects and multi-leg joint state distributions empirically; keep predictors causal and exact-SHA
model_contracts.micro_maker: alias for professional_market_maker; the old generic maker-disabled interpretation is superseded. Unconditional always-improve remains rejected, but bounded PAPER exploration and EV-optimized market making are authorized.
model_contracts.pca: low-priority single-leg residual statistical arbitrage only; evaluate 30m, 1h, 2h and 6h separately; no mandatory hedge basket, terminal-probability semantics or binary Kelly
model_contracts.local_factor: low-priority pair-specific panels, pair-excluded orientation-invariant factor basis, same-basis null-preserving inference, dependence-robust multiplicity, horizon-matched forecasts and explicit execution economics

rules: maker fast-path decisions are event-driven rather than timer-driven; execution_seconds are latency/refresh experiment buckets only
keep state, PnL, labels and inference separate by frequency
do not select a new frequency post hoc on the same holdout
new frequencies require prospective chronological evidence
frozen holdout evidence and adaptive walk-forward evidence must never be mixed

current_priority_order: Professional Market Making V7: make it the primary economic system. Reuse current reward scanner and shared C++ WebSocket L2; build dynamic rewarded-market selection, action-specific fill/markout learning, inventory control, complete-set accounting, reward/rebate-aware EV, cold-start PAPER exploration and canonical ledger evidence.

Maker latency: move the quote decision/cancel path fully onto the shared event-driven C++ WebSocket state. REST/public polling is slow-path control/bootstrap only. Measure end-to-end feed, decision and cancel latency and aggressively reduce p50/p95/p99 tails without weakening causal/safety checks.

Maker evidence: generate many small causal PAPER quote decisions/fills, learn from exact-SHA ledger data, keep exploration out of promotion credit, and optimize realized trading PnL + separately reported maker rebates + liquidity rewards.
Repair any current bug that invalidates economic or exact-SHA evidence, including missing V7 cutover primitives caused by the premature cleanup.

Fast Structural Arb/HFT: keep always on as a secondary low-model-risk opportunity lane with event-driven L2, strict dual-clock freshness, depth, fees, latency, partial/unwind and cost-stressed PAPER evidence.
Graph/RV execution: retain as secondary structural relative-value lane and improve empirical joint completion and total executable EV.
External Fair Value and toxicity context: continue point-in-time data collection in parallel.
Cross-sectional Ranking, PCA and Local Factor: maintain correctness and collect evidence, but do not consume primary engineering capacity until market-making execution is mature.
Restore one economically useful V7 monitoring/deploy/health plane without resurrecting retired numerical generations.

After one exact V7 SHA is on main, paper-validated, deployed and server-health green, aggressively delete every remaining superseded adapter/workflow/config/test/dashboard/transitional bridge no longer imported by V7/common.

forbidden_regressions: Do not create V8/V9/V10 or another numerical runtime generation.
Do not create a second market-maker runtime, WebSocket market-data plane, state writer, broker, execution ledger or canonical integration; reuse V7/common and the shared C++ fast feed.
Do not add new strategy/runtime logic to V3/V4/V5/V6 or resurrect them wholesale.
Do not delete or omit V7 cutover primitives required for same-SHA PAPER -> main -> paper-validated -> deploy -> health.
Do not add authenticated or real-money execution during this mission.
Do not treat maker reward pools, projected reward share, quote count, quoted spread, assumed fills, in-sample Sharpe or CI success as profitable alpha.
Do not require directional alpha as a generic prerequisite for a maker quote; require controlled maker EV or bounded PAPER exploration instead.
Do not resurrect unconditional improve1; quote improvement must win on action-specific fill-conditioned EV after adverse selection, inventory, latency and reward economics.
Do not let reward minimum size, queue ahead or theoretical pool share grant extra capital capacity.
Do not use product/minimum of marginal fill probabilities as a generic multi-leg joint completion estimator.
Do not mix frozen-holdout evidence with adaptive refits or pool ranking/PCA evidence across horizons.
Do not write scheduler-generated code or artifacts outside authorized repository/runtime/evidence paths; the portfolio workspace is read-only by default.
